note: ECONOMY ENGINEER: this section is yours. It holds the alerts of the energy system, which docs/specs/03_gameplay/02_economy.md re-themes as Provisions fed by Grain, and of the fuel system, whose bar reads Stored Essence. The keys, placeholders and icons are fixed by the game; the wording may change as long as every placeholder and icon of the installed key stays (the sweep refuses a row that loses one). docs/design/stage2/economy.md did not exist when this file was written, so the wording follows the economy spec.
